gloss: one place; one spot; a single location

definitions.gloss: one place; one spot; one point
definitions.explanation: A single location, spot, or point. Used both for physical places and abstract points (such as a single error in a document or a single spot on the body).

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put all luggage together in one place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: There was just one spot in the document that needed correction, so I fixed it right away.

notes:
A counting expression for places, spots, or locations. Written as {一箇所|いっかしょ} or {一|いっ}カ{所|しょ} or {一|いっ}ヶ{所|しょ}. The counter ⟦{箇所|かしょ}→箇所：00196_kasho⟧ is used widely for discrete spots, points of interest, or specific locations.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}: one place
- {二箇所|にかしょ}: two places
- {三箇所|さんかしょ}: three places
- {数箇所|すうかしょ}: several places
- {何箇所|なんかしょ}: how many places

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to gather in one place
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to assemble in one spot
- {一箇所|いっかしょ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: just one spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: one place — more colloquial
- {一|いっ}か{所|しょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧: to concentrate in one spot — emphasizes consolidation
